description: This file defines a static class 'CrossPlatformInputManager' responsible for managing cross-platform input methods, including handling virtual axes and buttons, switching input sources (hardware or touch), and providing access to input states for a Unity project.

classes.name: CrossPlatformInputManager
classes.description: A static class that manages cross-platform input devices, virtual axes, and buttons, providing methods to register, unregister, query, and set input states, as well as switch between input methods.

classes.name: VirtualAxis
classes.description: Represents a virtual axis that can be updated and queried for its value, used for touch or other non-hardware input methods.

classes.name: VirtualButton
classes.description: Represents a virtual button with states for pressed, released, and held, suitable for touch or in-game UI controls.

methods.name: SwitchActiveInputMethod
methods.description: Switches the active input method between hardware and touch based on the provided enumeration.

methods.name: AxisExists
methods.description: Checks if a virtual axis with the specified name exists.

methods.name: ButtonExists
methods.description: Checks if a virtual button with the specified name exists.

methods.name: RegisterVirtualAxis
methods.description: Registers a new virtual axis into the input system.

methods.name: RegisterVirtualButton
methods.description: Registers a new virtual button into the input system.

methods.name: UnRegisterVirtualAxis
methods.description: Unregisters a virtual axis by name.

methods.name: UnRegisterVirtualButton
methods.description: Unregisters a virtual button by name.

methods.name: VirtualAxisReference
methods.description: Returns a reference to a virtual axis, if it exists.

methods.name: GetAxis
methods.description: Retrieves the value of the axis with the specified name, optionally raw.

methods.name: GetAxisRaw
methods.description: Retrieves the raw value of the axis with the specified name.

methods.name: GetButton
methods.description: Checks if the specified virtual button is currently pressed.

methods.name: GetButtonDown
methods.description: Checks if the specified virtual button was pressed this frame.

methods.name: GetButtonUp
methods.description: Checks if the virtual button was released this frame.

methods.name: SetButtonDown
methods.description: Simulates pressing down a virtual button.

methods.name: SetButtonUp
methods.description: Simulates releasing a virtual button.

methods.name: SetAxisPositive
methods.description: Sets specified axis to a positive value.

methods.name: SetAxisNegative
methods.description: Sets specified axis to a negative value.

methods.name: SetAxisZero
methods.description: Resets the specified axis to zero.

methods.name: SetAxis
methods.description: Sets the specified axis to a given float value.

methods.name: mousePosition
methods.description: Gets the current virtual mouse position.

methods.name: SetVirtualMousePositionX
methods.description: Sets the virtual mouse position along the X axis.

methods.name: SetVirtualMousePositionY
methods.description: Sets the virtual mouse position along the Y axis.

methods.name: SetVirtualMousePositionZ
methods.description: Sets the virtual mouse position along the Z axis.
